overview.title: Green folds close to town
overview.p1: The Tizguit area offers valley greenery and simple walking without the full logistics of Michlifen or a long forest drive. It suits travellers who want nature on a lighter scale.
overview.p2: Paths and viewpoints vary with season and recent rain. Ask locally for the current easy loop if you are without a guide.
overview.p3: One to two hours covers a satisfying stretch. Return to Ifrane for lunch or continue toward a lake.
